paper.title: A Dynamic Robotic Actuator with Variable Physical Stiffness and Damping
paper.locator: Fig. 5 geometry and Section 3 Figs. 10–14; motor 1 fixed, external torque applied to output, ATI Gamma z-axis calibrated for ±10 N m. The paper identifies Figs. 10–12 as different summaries of the same measurements.

source_fields.time: Relative experimental seconds. All 24 files have monotonically increasing 1 ms sample increments to 1e-9 s tolerance.
source_fields.ToSensor: Measured output torque in N m. Counts above ±10 N m indicate values outside the published calibrated sensor range; these alone do not establish sensor clipping or a motor limit.
source_fields.alpha: Output deflection in radians per source geometry. Verified etaactual = phiactual + alpha on every relevant row (absolute tolerance 1e-8 rad).
source_fields.rset and ractual: Commanded and measured pivot radii in meters, converted to mm. Files differ in startup state. Retain actual commanded values separately from filename labels.
source_fields.Jup3TargetTorque / ToEstimated / T1 T2 T: Distinct channels. Motor-3 command, estimated torque, motor channels and external output torque must not be substituted. Published engineering conversion for the raw drive-current fields was not established.

fixed_radius_analysis: 19 files, indexed by the nominal radius in the filename. Fit a signed least-squares affine ToSensor(alpha) relation separately for each run using motors active, endstop inactive, abs(ToSensor)<=10 N m, rset matching nominal within 1e-7 mm, and abs(ractual-nominal)<=0.5 mm. Retain fit rows, slope/intercept, in-sample RMS and R². This descriptive pooled slope includes loading/unloading hysteresis and is sensitive to angle sampling. It is not a tangent stiffness, an identified torque bias, an independent validation or the pointwise torque/deflection metric in Fig. 11.
pulse_analysis: Four files contribute eight direction-specific summaries. Repeated per-file rows/flags in both direction rows count each file only once. Use transitions in rset, require motor-on/endstop-off from the preceding sample to the next command or file end and starting ractual within 10% of the previous level (tolerance scaled by command amplitude). Report first observed crossing of 90% of the commanded change in that direction. Denominators before filtering, after filtering and crossing counts are saved separately. No interpolation, imputation, pooling of directions, settling-time assumption or independence claim for repeated pulses. Fig. 14 uses selected small/large steps, so these whole-file statistics need not reproduce its values.
calibration_analysis: T3calib is a separate actuator-3 command/Tz sensor calibration acquisition with a different schema. Summarize logged channel extrema and duration only; no thermal/current limit or inferred unit conversion.
data_quality: In r1to9mm, the logged setpoints are 1 and 19.5 mm. In r8to14mm, they are 6 and 19.5 mm. In r11to19mm, the upper recorded level is 19.5 mm. r1to19mm logs 1 and 19 mm.
The r2mm spring-identification file contains 1 and 2 mm commands. The fit uses the documented nominal 2 mm stage only.

For the 19 spring runs, 41,306 motor-on/endstop-off samples exceed the stated ATI calibration band; the fit excludes these values. Torque sign is the native sensor sign, and the fitted intercept cannot establish a true sensor bias.
